_doc: Operator/agent WATCH-BENCH: names you're monitoring for rotation/watch — NOT held (those are the book) and NOT peers (those live in research_cache/peer_set). The cockpit crawl's WATCH section shows these; the M5 orchestrator prices them via FMP and injects them as `monitored` into build_matrix_state. Edit freely; agents and the matchup desk may append here. Use full exchange tickers (e.g. U.UN.TO).
